connector.name: Yandex Metrica MCP by askads
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Yandex Metrica API: list counters, goals and pull web-analytics statistics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-yandex-metrica. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the askads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_TOKEN
env.description: Yandex Metrica OAuth token (scope metrika:read) — read access to analytics data. Treat it as a secret.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID
env.description: Default Metrica counter id, used when a tool call omits counterId.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_API_BASE
env.description: API root host. Override only for a proxy or a non-default endpoint.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Max retries for transient errors (429 rate limit, 5xx on reads).
